# Weeber

> AI voice agents for businesses that miss calls.

## What is Weeber?

Weeber is a vertical voice AI platform that gives Shopify stores, clinics, and local service businesses an AI agent on a real phone number. The agent recovers abandoned carts, confirms COD orders, books appointments, and handles inbound calls — 24/7, no code required.

## Who is it for?

- Shopify and e-commerce stores losing revenue to abandoned carts and missed calls
- Clinics and healthcare practices that need automated appointment booking
- Local service businesses (salons, restaurants, repair shops) that can't staff phones full-time

## Key capabilities

- Cart recovery calls: automated outbound calls to recover abandoned Shopify carts
- COD confirmation: voice verification of cash-on-delivery orders to reduce RTO
- Feedback collection: post-delivery satisfaction calls with 1-5 ratings
- Appointment booking: inbound and outbound scheduling for service businesses
- Bilingual support: English and Hindi with natural conversational AI
- Compliance-first: TCPA, DNC, and GDPR enforcement built into the infrastructure

## Compliance

Weeber enforces consent at the infrastructure level. Calls cannot be placed to numbers that haven't passed the consent gate. Features include:
- Automatic Do-Not-Call list management
- TCPA calling-window enforcement by timezone
- Full audit trail for every call (exportable)
- GDPR data retention and erasure support

## Integrations

- Shopify (live)
- WhatsApp (live)
- WordPress, Google Calendar, HubSpot, Meta (roadmap)
